intro: A smart locker with an advanced magnetic strip card reader that allows access using a registered debit/credit card or a 4–6 digit password. Featuring a motorized lock, heavy-duty keypad, auto-freeze security, USB emergency power, and override key, it ensures reliable protection and convenient access. Its sleek design blends seamlessly with modern interiors, making security both stylish and discreet.

features.title: Dual Access Control (Digital + Magnetic Strip Reader)
features.text: Unlock your locker using either a registered credit/debit card or a 4–6 digit personal password. This dual-access system offers the perfect balance of convenience and secure control for everyday use.

features.title: Ultimate Security with Advanced Motorised Shooting Bolts
features.text: Powered by an internal motor, these bolts remain firmly locked until the correct Password / Card is authorised, ensuring the safe cannot be opened forcefully through magnet manipulation or vigorous shaking.

features.title: Low Battery Alert
features.text: Get alerts when your battery is running low, ensuring you never miss a beat. Godrej Home Lockers help you stay ahead of power disruptions, ensuring constant security for your valuables.

features.title: Autolock Keypad Freeze Function
features.text: Automatic sensor freeze function keeps your valuables safe by preventing unauthorised access after 4 consecutive wrong password entries.

features.title: Emergency Mechanical Override and External USB Charging Support
features.text: In the event of a low-battery condition, the lock offers an emergency mechanical override key to ensure uninterrupted access. Additionally, the external USB charging provision enables immediate power restoration, maintaining seamless and reliable operation at all times.

features.title: Provision for audit trail
features.text: Stores up to 100 records of locker activity, including the date, time, and mode of locking or unlocking. The records can be conveniently viewed directly through the locker.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. It is Recommended to anchor the Locker with bolts from the bottom as well as the back into a cupboard or onto the wall.
name: E Swipe El Silver Digital Locker With Magnetic Card Access
